new.brief: Creates an action that when activated, emits the given action signal on the provided widget.
new.md:
Creates an action that when activated, emits the given action signal
on the provided widget.

It will also unpack the args into arguments passed to the signal.

doc.brief: Emits a signal on a widget.
doc.md:
Emits a signal on a widget.

Signals that are used in this way are referred to as keybinding signals,
and they are expected to be defined with the `G_SIGNAL_ACTION` flag.

get_signal_name.brief: Returns the name of the signal that will be emitted.
get_signal_name.md: Returns the name of the signal that will be emitted.

signal-name.brief: The name of the signal to emit.
signal-name.md: The name of the signal to emit.
